admin.subtitle: Code lists and rates the app looks up. Each sheet applies from its start date until the next one.

history.open: History is open: past sheets can still be edited
history.openText: Fill in the past while you set the table up. Close history once the data is right: from then on only future sheets change, and the sheet in force only through a correction.
history.confirmText: Past sheets and the sheet in force become read-only for good. Changes from today on need a correction with a reason.

timeline.title: Sheets
timeline.none: No sheets yet. Start one with New sheet.
timeline.noneWorkspace: This workspace has no sheets of its own: the global sheets apply.
timeline.globalApplies: No sheet of this workspace is in force yet: the global sheet applies until then.

sheet.title: Sheet from {date}
sheet.newText: The new sheet starts as a copy of the latest sheet at this level.
sheet.anyDay: Any day while history is open.
sheet.redateText: Move the sheet to another start date.
sheet.deleteText: The sheet and its rows are removed. Lookups on its days use the sheet before it.
sheet.lockedPast: Locked: this sheet is in the past
sheet.readOnly: Read-only: you can't change sheets at this level.

correct.title: Correct from today
correct.text: Saves a new sheet from today with these rows. The sheet in force stays as it was for the days before.
correct.warning: Applies to every lookup from now on.

errors.refdata_sheet_locked: This sheet is locked: it is in force or in the past.
errors.refdata_date_taken: Another sheet at this level already starts on that day.
errors.refdata_date_in_past: History is closed: pick tomorrow or a later day.
errors.refdata_reason_required: Give a reason for the correction.
errors.refdata_ref_inactive: This code is not active on the sheet's start date.
